name: rezen-reader
description: Lets your chief of staff read your deals in reZEN: open transactions, contract dates, who is on each file, and the checklist. Read-only. It never creates, edits, sends or signs anything.
long_description: A read-only window into Real's reZEN for the Reframe Lab Chief of Staff. Generate an API key in reZEN (three-dot menu, Security Settings, Recent API Key, Generate Key), paste it here once, and Claude can answer: where are we on the Johnsons, what is still open on the contract, what closes in the next ten days. The key is stored in your computer's keychain, never in a file. Nothing is ever written to reZEN. Commission and payout figures are left out unless you ask for them.
